title: morus rubra var. murrayana
intro: Morus rubra var. murrayana, commonly known as Red Mulberry, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to North America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues, such as diarrhea and inflammation, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Red Mulberry are attributed to its ability to reduce fever, aid in digestion, and act as a laxative, which are associated with its bioactive constituents, including anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. These bioactive constituents also contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a valuable plant for traditional medicine.
